connectivity_protocol.adjacency: Two distinct feasible K-subsets are adjacent iff their Hamming distance is two
connectivity_protocol.cache_semantics: The seven coherent V3.9 caches are deterministic functions of a portfolio and are not additional graph vertices
connectivity_protocol.component_algorithm: Deterministic disjoint-set union over all equal nine-element cores
connectivity_protocol.completeness_argument: The four authenticated ten-asset groups partition all forty assets. Enumerating every allowed local subset and every four-way product whose counts sum to ten emits each group-valid exact-K portfolio exactly once; exact factor filtering then emits the complete feasible vertex set.
connectivity_protocol.edge_core_theorem: For distinct ten-subsets S and T, Hamming distance two is equivalent to existence of one unique nine-subset C with C subset S and C subset T

graph_definition.vertices: ALL N=40 K=10 PORTFOLIOS SATISFYING FOUR GROUP BANDS AND THREE EXACT DYADIC FACTOR BANDS

evidence_contract.immutability: An existing non-identical artifact is never overwritten
